limitations: Focal cell-week predictions are retained on Atlas and require authorized descriptive extraction for final map rendering.
P6 support classes are complete only for selected replay windows, so a continuous focal support time series is not source-complete.
The 34-predictor coefficient artifact mixes standardized continuous predictors with unscaled indicators/calendar terms; no global coefficient-magnitude ranking is defensible.
Coefficient stability is canonically available for four augmented predictors, not all 34 predictors.
The focal crop has domain-region labels but not a retained state-boundary intersection table.
separate_analytic_authorization: SHAP, permutation importance, ALE, partial dependence, or leave-one-predictor-out refitting.
Any refitting or feature-selection analysis to support a stronger predictor-contribution claim.
